# Messages generated by protoc for the tests of the protobuf support (aeronet_proto_test namespace), for the runtime
# selected by AERONET_PROTOBUF_RUNTIME: generated code must be built for the runtime it is linked with.
if(AERONET_PROTOBUF_RUNTIME STREQUAL "lite")
  set(AERONET_TEST_PROTO_OPTIMIZE_FOR LITE_RUNTIME)
else()
  set(AERONET_TEST_PROTO_OPTIMIZE_FOR SPEED)
endif()

set(_aeronet_test_proto_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proto")
set(_aeronet_test_protos)
foreach(_proto IN ITEMS aeronet-test aeronet-test-required)
  configure_file(${_proto}.proto.in "${_aeronet_test_proto_dir}/${_proto}.proto" @ONLY)
  list(APPEND _aeronet_test_protos "${_aeronet_test_proto_dir}/${_proto}.proto")
endforeach()

# Not a project library: the generated code is compiled without the warnings and clang-tidy of the project.
set(_aeronet_test_proto_out_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_aeronet_test_proto_out_dir}")
add_library(aeronet_test_protos STATIC)
protobuf_generate(
  TARGET aeronet_test_protos
  LANGUAGE cpp
  PROTOS ${_aeronet_test_protos}
  IMPORT_DIRS "${_aeronet_test_proto_dir}"
  PROTOC_OUT_DIR "${_aeronet_test_proto_out_dir}"
)
target_include_directories(aeronet_test_protos SYSTEM PUBLIC "${_aeronet_test_proto_out_dir}")
target_link_libraries(aeronet_test_protos PUBLIC ${AERONET_PROTOBUF_TARGET})
